activity.notes: Minamoto no Yoritomo established nationwide warrior rule and was appointed shogun in 1192, serving until his death in 1199. Consistent with the existing Ashikaga convention, ATLAS attaches the shogunal office to the higher-order Japan polity rather than creating the bakufu as a separate territorial polity.
